notes.title: v.0.2.1 - Map Fixes and Seeded Runs
notes.notes:
The update adds some fixes for bugs noted with the map, along with adding seeded runs to the game!

There is a known visual bug with the map - if you continue an existing run, the map texture won't appear along with the map. I'll work on that and update as soon as possible. Otherwise, everything should be in order.

As always, let me know if you come across any issues!

notes.title: Playtest Updated to v0.2
notes.notes:
Just updated the playtest to v0.2. 

[b]NOTE: THIS VERSION CONTAINS ONLY ONE REGION.[/b]

This version features the redesigned Pond environment, with redesigned enemies, a new boss, new tiles, and reworked weapons. It also features a number of visual updates and changes, such as lighting and post-processing, additional background elements, and more.

Notably, this version also features control support.
